query_text: Create a dumbbell chart showing the top 8 ecosystems with the largest absolute disagreement between `Funding rank` and `Value rank` within the Europe section, using ecosystems where `Total Early-Stage Funding` and `Ecosystem Value` are both exact values; the left endpoint shows rank by `Total Early-Stage Funding`, the right endpoint shows rank by `Ecosystem Value`, values are expressed in `rank position`, and items are sorted descending by absolute rank gap.
sort_rule: descending by absolute rank gap, ties broken by lower funding_rank then entity

plot_spec.title: 2021 Europe Funding vs Value Rank Gap
